obfuscation_indicators: may cause actual results to differ materially
risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail on revenue, customer concentration, geographic exposure, margins, and litigation, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language for outlook items. The $1.54 billion CMU judgment, potential royalties of up to $400 million, customer concentration, Asian sales exposure, and inventory and demand volatility represent significant credit risks. Operating performance is presented positively, though the anticipated first-quarter revenue decline and margin pressure temper the tone.
